class.name: FoxZoomSpringArm3D
class.brief_description: An extended [SpringArm3D] designed for camera controllers.
class.description: It overrides standard length adjustments with smooth, frame-independent zoom interpolation and provides a dedicated API for stepping the zoom in and out.

method.name: zoom_in
method.description: Decreases the target length by the [member zoom_step], bringing the camera closer.

method.name: zoom_out
method.description: Increases the target length by the [member zoom_step], pushing the camera further away.

method.name: change_zoom
method.description: Directly modifies the target length by a specific [param amount], clamping it to [member max_length].

method.name: get_zoom_percentage
method.description: Returns the current visual zoom as a decimal between [code]0.0[/code] and [code]1.0[/code].

members.member: The maximum distance the arm can zoom out.
The amount of length added or subtracted per zoom input.
How quickly the camera interpolates to the target zoom. Higher values mean faster zooming.
Determines if the node currently accepts zoom inputs.
The desired length the arm is currently interpolating towards.

signal.name: length_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the arm's zoom distance visually changes.

signal.name: zoom_min_reached
signal.description: Emitted the moment the arm's length reaches 0.0. Useful for hiding the player mesh.

signal.name: zoom_max_reached
signal.description: Emitted the moment the arm reaches its [member max_length].

signal.name: zoom_finished
signal.description: Emitted when the arm finishes interpolating and completely settles on the [member target_length].
